text:
Priya Mehta: OK team — kicking off SI onboarding pilot next Wed 9am PT. Goal: certify first 5 partners (hardware + cloud marketplace enablement) in 2 weeks. Agenda: 1) orientation 2) hands-on lab 3) badging exam. Docs: https://redwood.ai/si/onboard-pilot (draft)
Lucas Chen: +1. Can eng provide demo env? we need a pre-provisioned Dedicated pool and sandbox keys.
Diego Alvarez: I can provision a small Dedicated pool & VPC tomorrow. Will attach terraform quickstart.
Ruth Kim: Training plan draft attached. Proposed cadence: 90m orientation, 3h lab, 60m exam. Prefer 2 cohorts per week.
Maya Torres: I can run the hands-on lab + scripts. Need a checklist for partner accounts + marketplace listing guidance.
Priya Mehta: Here’s the minimal checklist we’ll use:
```
- Partner legal LOI signed
- Sandbox VPC + keys
- Test dataset + PII scrubbed
- Marketplace publisher account
- Support contact + escalation path
```
Diego Alvarez: FYI infra limits: Dedicated pool + 2 GPUs per partner. If more, request quota increase via #eng-infra.
Lucas Chen: We should add a quick runbook for failover: model fallback -> lower quantization -> degrade to smaller model.
Ruth Kim: I'll build a short cert exam (10 Qs) + lab rubrics. Would like input on pass threshold (suggest 80%).
Priya Mehta: @Maya can you draft the marketplace listing checklist? @Diego can you share terraform snippet in thread?
Maya Torres: Yep, will drop checklist by EOD and a slide deck for the orientation.
Diego Alvarez: Terraform snippet: 
```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "si_pilot" {
  gpus = 2
  region = "us-west-2"
}
```
Ruth Kim: Quick poll — 80% pass threshold ok? :thumbsup: for yes :thumbsdown: for no
Lucas Chen: :thumbsup:
Priya Mehta: Thanks all. Action items: Maya slide deck + checklist (EOD), Diego terraform (done), Ruth exam draft (tomorrow), Lucas confirm demo models. Will run dry-run with internal SIs on Friday.
onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled: SI pilot orientation — 2025-04-02 16:00 UTC
Maya Torres: noted. I'll bring breakout lab facilitators.
Priya Mehta: Great. tagging @here for any other stake holders. End of thread.
